english.title: Under 18 years of age being supervised fire air weapon beyond premises
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person of or over the age of 21 who had the supervision of **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), a person under the age of 18 who had with

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

an air weapon, namely **(..SPECIFY WEAPON..), on premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), in circumstances where possession would have been prohibited but for section 23(1) of the Firearms Act 1968, allowed that person to use the air weapon for firing a missile beyond those premises
english.legislation: Contrary to section 23(1) of and Schedule 6 to the Firearms Act 1968.
